main:1.page: A Rock and a Hard Place
main:1.text: Nate woke up inside a train wagon and quickly realized he was bleeding heavily from a wound in his abdomen. It slowly began to dawn on him that the carriage was hanging down from a cliff as several objects began falling down toward him, followed by his bench, and ultimately himself as well. Fortunately, he broke his fall on the exterior handrail at the lower end of the carriage.

main:2.text: Nate and Flynn began following their path through the sewers, looking for a way into the museum. After climbing just a few pipes and ledges, the two came to a dead end, but Nate spotted above him a brick-lined shaft that would take them up into the boiler room. Flynn gave Nate a boost up, and the latter led the way inside.

main:3.text: Borneo is the third chapter of Among Thieves. Nate and Sully ventured into Borneo to find Lazarević's camp, meanwhile arming the explosive charges that Chloe had planted for the planned diversion. Completing the chapter in less than 6 minutes and 30 seconds in Among Thieves Remastered will unlock the silver trophy "Staying Dry". Nate and Sully began their venture into the Borneo jungle in search of Lazarević's camp.

main:4.text: After planting the explosive charges and traveling through the Borneo jungle, Nate and Sully managed to arrive at Lazarević's camp. They spotted Chloe, and spied Lazarević arguing with Flynn about his lack of results, until a soldier exposed another for stealing artifacts. Lazarević killed the man with a knife for his insubordination, erupting into anger afterwards.

main:5.text: Completing the chapter in less than 7 minutes and 30 seconds in Among Thieves Remastered will unlock the gold trophy Quick Jaunt Through a Warzone. After Nate survived the crash of his jeep he was forced to outrun the armored truck chasing him, eventually causing it to explode. As he got his bearings he checked his map looking for the route to the Old Market where he was supposed to reunite with Chloe.

main:6.text: After exiting from a wrecked building, Nate and Chloe came to a plaza in front of a small temple, where they witnessed resistance fighters being gunned down. As they took cover behind two statues, they spotted several soldiers patrolling the area. Not liking the odds, Nate suggested they find an alternate route to avoid a fight altogether.

main:7.text: As they fought through two groups and crossed a river, the three finally managed to make it to the temple Nate and Chloe were looking for, indicated by the symbol of the Cintamani Stone on its facade. Nate explained this to Elena and Jeff, who found it stupid that he was competing with a psychopathic war criminal for a mythological gemstone.

main:8.text: Inside the temple Nate and Chloe quickly caught sight of a massive statue, holding a representation of the Cintamani Stone, as well as various objects in its other arms. Nate recognized the statue and looked inside his journal for notes, which indicated that the statue's objects and arms needed to be in specific positions.

main:9.text: Nate and Chloe quickly discovered that the mirrors atop the stairs at the room's entrance could be used to redirect the light, and that the large stone faces' third eyes served as a receptacle for said light. Each face contained a lock fitted for the Phurba Nate held, which in turn caused one of the larger Phurba's blades to descend.

main:10.text: Nate knew that to get this far into the temple they must have had gone right through Jeff and Elena. Worried, he ran back through the temple path, killing several soldiers that got in their way. Eventually they reached the entrance where they found out Elena and Jeff were under attack by a group of soldiers, with snipers having cut off their path, until Nate and Chloe eliminated them all.

main:11.text: The group managed to make it through several streets, each time barely making it past several soldiers, until they finally found their way into a building and a momentary reprieve from the chasing soldiers. The group realizes they are in trouble when they get stuck inside a room, with the only way out being a large drop. Chloe reassured them that they could make the jump, but Elena noted that Jeff could not.

main:12.text: Upon reaching a balcony, Nate and Elena observed a group of soldiers patrolling a plaza below. Though unarmed, Nate neutralized the hostiles and secured weapons; meanwhile, Elena acquired a 92FS - 9mm after Nate boosted her up to a fire escape. Their path toward the railyard was eventually blocked by a locked gate, forcing Nate to find a vantage point to shoot out the wooden planks securing it.

main:13.text: Locomotion is the thirteenth chapter of Among Thieves. With help from Elena, Nate boarded Lazarević's train in order to find Chloe, thinking she was in need of a rescue. During the chapter he is attacked by a helicopter, until he barely escapes it thanks to a tunnel. Completing the chapter in less than 6 minutes in Among Thieves Remastered will unlock the bronze trophy Bullet Train From Hell.

main:14.text: Tunnel Vision is the fourteenth chapter of Among Thieves. Nate boarded Lazarević's train in order to find Chloe, during which he is attacked by a helicopter, and gets into a firefight with Draza. After making it through the tunnel Nate is assailed by a group of Draza's men, who resorted to calling in their attack helicopter when Nate defeated them all.

main:15.text: The start of the chapter began immediately after the opening cutscene of the game in "A Rock and a Hard Place", with some minor cuts made to speed up the climb through the train car, along with some additional commentary by Nate that was not present in the first chapter.

main:16.text: Nate followed the stranger through the village, meanwhile trying to talk with the other people he encountered, although none of them understood English. He also tried to figure out where he was based on his surroundings, but all he could see were tall mountains. After following the man to a house at the end of the village, Nate found Elena playing with the stranger's daughter while waiting for him.

main:17.text: While making their way through the caves, Nate and Tenzin spotted a small pack of wolves, although this did not deter them from going deeper. Shortly after they discovered a body, and learned it was one of Schäfer's men based on a drawing of the Cintamani Stone. The bridge on which the body lay collapsed at that point, with the two barely escaping certain death.

main:18.text: In the temple Nate and Tenzin have to split up and make use of several levers and pressure switches to enable the other party to make their way across. The contraptions on Nate's side are notably more deteriorated however, forcing him to take longer and make detours compared to Tenzin. Ultimately the two succeed in raising the bridge that granted them access to the temple's inner chamber.

main:19.text: After making their way through the village Nate and Tenzin managed to reach the latter's house, but did not find Pema nor Schäfer within the premises. At his balcony Tenzin asked for Nate's binoculars, and quickly spotted Schäfer holding Pema deeper within the village. He then had Nate look, who also saw them, as well as a tank.

main:20.text: After the tank destroyed Tenzin's home, he and Nate ran for cover. While many of the villagers attempted to fight back, the tank's armor made it impenetrable as it continued to mow down almost everyone in sight and destroy the village. While avoiding the tank's firepower, Nate and Tenzin made their way across the village, fending off Zoran's soldiers along the way.

main:21.text: Once Nate and Elena caught up to Lazarević's convoy, Nate attempted to clear the road by leaping from truck to truck and gunning down the soldiers, while Elena took the wheel and tried to keep up. Nate soon took control of a mounted grenade launcher that a soldier was operating, and cleared the path of vehicles behind him while also protecting Elena from the trucks attempting to ram her off-road.

main:22.text: After entering the monastery Nate and Elena fight their way through a large group of soldiers, until they eventually manage to spot Lazarević moving Schäfer into a tower deeper within the complex. They attempt to follow, and after several more firefights are almost stopped by a large group of soldiers armed with Dragon Snipers, until Nate manages to defeat them.

main:23.text: After surviving an ambush Nate and Elena stumble upon a wounded Schäfer, who immediately pointed out that Nate was right about everything he touches turning to shit. He refused Elena's attempt to help him get up, and instead asked if Nate had found his expedition, and if he understood why he killed his fellow expeditionists.

main:24.text: Nate and Elena first explored the room at the bottom of the secret entrance in the monastery, during which they solved the first part of the puzzle involving rotating several large decorative Phurbas placed on the walls. The Cintamani Stone-like object representing it then slightly rose into the air, although upon his approach Nate and Elena heard shouts coming from above.

main:25.text: Thanks to the distraction from the guardians, Nate, Elena, and Chloe were able to break free from Lazarević and his men. As they fled, several of Zoran's soldiers caught up to them. One wielding an RPG - 7 was prepared to finish them off, when a guardian pounced on him at the same time he fired. This destabilized the large stone platform Nate and his allies had leaped onto.

main:26.text: Completing the chapter without dying on Normal difficulty or harder in Among Thieves Remastered will unlock the bronze trophy "YOLO Among Thieves". Shortly after the start of the chapter, Nate entered the core area of the Tree of Life, and spied on Lazarević who had arrived there before him, alongside a handful of accompanying men.
